landing_intro: The D-guild within TLTH is a non-profit organisation for students and alumni of the Computer Science and InfoCom programs. The guild organises social events, industry contacts, study monitoring, and everything else that helps students and alumni.
landing_party_description: The D-guild organises fun activities for the students during the semesters. Every fall, we organise the introduction for all new students to welcome them to the city, the education and the student life. During the year, we organise everything from parties and pubs to board game nights, LAN-parties and badminton. Keep track of our calendar to see what happens next!
landing_activity_description: The guild consists of 15 different committees, which all do different things, have different responsibilities, and together make the guild what it is. The committees do everything from organising activities and introduction to managing technical systems or spreading information. Regardless of what your interests are, there is something for you.

n0lla_n0llning_what_text: The weeks of n0llning are filled with lots of fun and varied activities where we hope there is something for everyone. The purpose of the n0llning is to give new students the opportunity to get to know other students, find a community, and discover what student life in Lund has to offer.
n0lla_n0llning_first_day: What happens on the first day?
n0lla_n0llning_first_day_text: On the first day, you will be assigned your mentor ("phadder") group, and together you will explore the campus and be introduced to the D-guild. After the tour, the phadders will offer dinner and a pleasant hangout.
n0lla_n0llning_group_text: You will be placed in a phadder group with other new students at the D-guild. In the group, you will have a bunch of phadders from different years who will help and support you and be able to answer all kinds of questions. The phadder group will be a safe point throughout the n0llning, but of course, there will be plenty of opportunities to get to know more new students, both at the D-guild and from other guild. Before the n0llning starts, you will be called by a phadder, if you do not receive this call before the 19th of August, we may have received the wrong phone number and then you are recommended to contact nollning@dsek.se
n0lla_todo_accommodation_text: In Lund, it can sometimes be a bit tricky to find accommodation - luckily, new students (first-year students) have priority for some accommodations. Contact AF Bostäder, BoPoolen, or a nation directly! Studentlund has some good tips that apply to all these options, as well as some other ways to find accommodation. Click in there and read up! If you still can't find a place to stay, ask around among the mentors and others for tips on temporary accommodation.
n0lla_todo_nations_text: In another part of the Lund student life, at the Nations, there are also lots of fun to have. Lund has several different nations that organise pubs, clubs, festivals, brunches, and more, and several nations also offer housing. To participate in this, you must be a member of Studentlund and registered in a specific nation. No need to stress, you don't need to register until a few weeks into the orientation!
n0lla_todo_list_text: To enjoy the start of your study period and the orientation, we have created a small packing list with things that are especially worth bringing as a new LTH student.
n0lla_packing_description: You who are reading this may be moving to Lund/nearby, perhaps from home for the first time. In addition to what you would usually bring, we have compiled a list of things below that are good to have with you for the n0llning and student life.
n0lla_packing_robust_clothing_descriptio: It's important to have shoes that can get a bit worn or dirty, as we students are outdoors a lot and on grassy areas. It's also good to have clothes you aren't too afraid of, but fear not, your dear Ouvve will be just that!
n0lla_packing_theme_outfits_description: Many parties in student life have themes, and it can be fun to have a fun and theme-aligned outfit. You can of course buy/create something new here, but if you already have things at home, it might be worth bringing them!
n0lla_packing_fancy_clothing: Clothes for the dress code "Dark suit"
n0lla_packing_fancy_clothing_description: See dress codes for what is included. We will have an event with the dress code "Dark suit" already in the first week, and in the end of the n0llning there will be an event for the dress code "Formal attire".
n0lla_packing_slasque_description: Put on the ouvve! Sometimes there is also a theme for the slasque. Then you can add theme-appropriate clothing on top of the ouvve.
n0lla_packing_mixed_suit_description:
Nicer everyday clothes. A blazer combined with something else, or just something that makes you feel good.
(We rarely have this dress code)
n0lla_packing_dark_suit_description: A dark suit or a nicer dress. A regular blue suit is also fine, or a skirt with a top as well.
n0lla_packing_frack_description: Long dress or tailcoat, but a dark suit is also fine.
n0lla_packing_needle_description: Your lovely ouvve is not supposed to be worn blank, it should be decorated with a bunch of patches! You will receive a lot of patches during the n0llning, and to put this on your ouvve it's nice to have a simple sewing kit close to hand. You can of course use textile glue, it's a popular choice by some lazier students, but it's not as robust.
n0lla_packing_money_description: In the start of the school year there are quite a few expenses. Course literature, first rent, furniture, Ouvve, event during the n0llning to name a few. If you are eligible for CSN, even it will not arrive in your account until after a few weeks, so keeping extra money on hand at the start is recommended!
n0lla_packing_bike_description: A bike is the Lund student's best friend. The whole town is made to be biked around and you rarely travel any distance longer than 15 minutes on a bike. In the start of the school year the pressure is high on bikes so if you are able to bring your own it will be more convenient.
n0lla_well_being_description: If you ever feel bad or feel mistreated during your time here at LTH and during the n0llning, there are several places you can turn to.
n0lla_well_being_student_health: There is also help available outside the guild such as Student Health at Lund University, the counsellors at LTH, and the Student Chaplains. Your health is important to us and we want to offer as safe an environment as possible, so never hesitate to contact the organisation you feel most comfortable with. You can always also contact those responsible at an event if something has happened.
n0lla_guild_tagline: Where studies and student life meet
n0lla_guild_description: At LTH there are eleven guilds and which guild you belong to depends on what you study. Those of us who study Computer Science, Information and Communication Technology ("InfoCom") or the VR/AR master programme belong to the D-guild. The guild deals with everything from study supervision to organising the n0llning. The guild also organises parties, study nights, LAN parties, board game nights, badminton, running, volleyball, trips to other universities, a job fair, tinkers with servers, runs a café, has a football team, a newspaper, develops our own website and an app. The guild has something for most people, and if there's something the guild doesn't do that you think should be done, there's often room to push your ideas through!
n0lla_guild_board_description: The guild is led by a great group of members, each responsible for their own area. The guild consists of 15 different committees, most of which are led by a board member.
n0lla_guild_board_president_description: leads the board and represents the guild externally.
n0lla_guild_board_vice_president_descrip: is the secretary, writes meeting protocols, and keeps governance documents updated.
n0lla_guild_board_information_descriptio: responsible for our graphic design, digital assets, archives, marketing and PR within the guild.
n0lla_guild_board_treasurer_description: is the guild's treasurer and expert in accounting.
n0lla_guild_board_cafe_description: runs the guild's café and hosts brunches.
n0lla_guild_board_study_president_descri: leads and organises the study monitoring work in the guild, and organises study nights.
n0lla_guild_board_corporate_relations_de: responsible for the guild's contact with the business community.
n0lla_guild_board_källarmästare_descript: responsible for the guild's premises, hardware, and car.
n0lla_guild_board_activities_description: organises everything between sports and games.
n0lla_guild_dchip_description: D-Chip is a non-profit, student-driven association at the D-guild to which students of Computer Science and InfoCom at LTH belong. All female and non-binary students in the two programs can join D-Chip. We exist to promote your well-being in the guild and to work for more female and non-binary engagement. On the Sunday before the n0llning starts (25th of August) D-Chip will organise a free lunch for all new students at the D-guild who identify as female or non-binary, more info will be given to you by your phadder before the 19th of august!

n0llning_landing_hello_body:
Welcome to the D-guild and to your next five years. We hope that you will enjoy your time here throughout your studies! When you arrive in Lund as a newly admitted student, you'll be bombarded with new impressions, people, places, and all sorts of strange things almost daily. To make this experience as smooth and fun as possible, you, as a n0lla, will go through an initiation period called the “N0llning.” The N0llning is one of the most enjoyable aspects of student life and will provide you with a great introduction to your new home. It's also the perfect opportunity to get to know many new friends, both fellow new students and senior students.

The schedule will be packed with fun activities, parties, and craziness. N0llning might therefore feel a bit intense. However, this is no problem as you have complete control over how much you want to participate in! We do recommend taking part as much as possible because the n0llning is just so incredibly fun!

Here you’ll find lots of useful information, and if you still have any questions about n0llning, your studies, or life in Lund, feel free to ask the phadders and peppare!
n0llning_landing_lore_body: The storm lingered long over Lund, and the flame of light flickered faintly. But just as the darkness and storm had swallowed the n0lla, the sky burst open in a blinding light. From the light, they emerged. The Stab. Guardians of the heavens and saviours of the n0lla. Sent from the gates where time stands still and peace is never broken, they now walk among the n0llor. Their mission is to ignite flames in the darkness, to carry the light of hope through the trials of the n0llning, and to watch over every n0lla as they take their first steps into the new unknown. The n0lla will be guided on a journey filled with joy, friendship, and adventure. For when the light returns, we know that a new beginning has taken its place, and the darkness has been banished for all eternity.
n0llning_wikia_student_health_well_being: At the guild, we have a Well-Being Council with Equal Treatment Representatives who are happy to listen to and help you. You can talk about something you've experienced, heard, or seen during the n0llning that didn't feel right, either to get help in the situation or just to share your thoughts. The Equal Treatment Representatives have a duty of confidentiality and will not share the information.
n0llning_wikia_student_health_counsellor: If you find yourself in a situation where you need support and advice, don't hesitate to contact the counsellors. It doesn't have to be study-related. They have a duty of confidentiality, and visits are free of charge.
n0llning_wikia_student_health_student_he: Welcome to Student Health! You can turn to us if you, for example, feel stressed, down, or have anxiety about speaking in public. You can also get support regarding your alcohol habits, if you have anxiety, or anything else related to your mental well-being connected to your study situation.
n0llning_wikia_student_health_priests_bo: The Student Priests specialise in crisis management and life crises. They also have absolute confidentiality. The Student Priests welcome everyone, regardless of faith or belief system.
n0llning_wikia_guild_body: The guild is where studies and student life meet. At LTH, there are eleven guilds, and which guild you belong to depends on what you study. We who study computer science or information and communication technology belong to the D-guild. The guild is involved in everything from study monitoring to organising the n0llning. The guild also organises parties, study nights, LAN parties, board game nights, badminton, running, volleyball, trips to other universities, a career fair, server tinkering, runs a café, has a football team, a newspaper, develops our own website and an app. The guild has something for most people, and if there's something the guild doesn't do that you think should be done, there's often room to push through your ideas!
n0llning_wikia_board_body: The guild is led by a wonderful group of board members, each responsible for their own area. The guild consists of 15 different committees, most of which are led by a board member.

contact_business: For companies, you are welcome to contact the Head of Corporate Relations.
contact_delta_prose: DELTA is the annual career fair organised by the D-guild, which is aimed towards students on the engineering programmes Computer Science and Engineering and Information and Communication Engineering. DELTA is one of the biggest events during the year for the guild and an excellent opportunity to present yourselves to the students.
contact_well_being: We are here for your well-being, in everything from the study environment to equal treatment. We work continuously to make sure that the guild has an including environment where you always feel welcome, regardless of who you are. You as a student must be heard! Therefore, do not hesitate to contact us if something happens or if you have thoughts on how we can improve the well-being of the guild!
contact_pm_prose: For help on how to use the website correctly, or to make sure you have the right permissions, contact the Head Processor.
contact_root_prose: For technical support, or in cases related to IT Security, contact the server responsible, root.
contact_media_prose: Press and media should contact the Union President,
documents_guild_meetings_prose: Guild meetings are held approximately four times per year and is the highest decision-making body of the guild. On the guild meetings, larger decisions are made, such as budget, governing documents and electing the board. All members have voting rights at the guild meetings.
documents_board_meetings_prose: Board meetings are held every Tuesday lunch during the study weeks in E:1124. Here, decisions are made about e.g. guidelines and election of volunteers. All members are welcome to attend and discuss, but only the board may vote.
documents_srd_meetings_prose: The Student Council meetings are held every Wednesday during the study weeks in E:1124. Here, all students are welcome to discuss the education and have opinions about how e.g. the courses are functioning.
positions_date_error: End date must be after start date
board_prose: The board are responsible for the operations of the guild, and consists of the Guild President, Vice Guild President, and most of the committee heads. They make decisions regarding what the guild should do, elect volunteers, and represent the guild externally. Many decisions are made on board meetings every Tuesday during the study weeks in E:1124, where all members are welcome.
applying_computer_science_desc: The Master of Science program in Computer Science and Engineering focuses on programming, computer engineering, and mathematics. During the first three years, you will learn to understand everything from how computers and networks are structured to how complex software is developed. In the final two years, you shape your own profile by choosing one of eight specialisations, such as Software Engineering, Machine Intelligence, Networks and Security, or Embedded Systems. Through project courses linked to real-world research and industry, you will also get to test your skills in practice ahead of your professional career.
applying_infocom_desc: The Master of Science program in Information and Communication Engineering Technologies, InfoCom, primarily revolves around networks, software, and usability. During the first half of the program, you will learn about software development, user experience, cybersecurity, and network architecture. Afterwards, you can deepen your expertise through elective specialisations in areas such as Software Systems, Security, or Usability and Design. The program includes several collaborative projects where you apply your skills to real-world challenges sourced directly from industry and cutting-edge research.
applying_vr_ar_desc: The Master's program in Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality is also aimed at international students and is taught in English. This program is all about exploring future possibilities within Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR). Recent advancements in computer graphics, sensors, and display technology offer outstanding opportunities to immerse users in virtual environments or to augment real-world surroundings. VR and AR technology represent a completely new computing paradigm that is finding its way into applications for industry, healthcare, education, and entertainment alike.
applying_student_desc: Do you wonder about what it's like studying at the university? On the Lund University website you can find more information about what it is like to study and being a student.
applying_housing_desc: Do you want to know more about finding housing in Lund? On the Studentlund website, you'll find information about different types of housing and housing queues, and other information you may want to know.
applying_studentlund_desc: The student life in Lund offers a multitude of opportunities, even outside the D-guild. On the Studentlund website, you can read more about the nations, the Academic Society (AF), and other associations.
